scope: All fixed-size, fixed-diameter non-singleton prime clusters along the fixed-M j=1 parameter line

quantifiers.diameter: Fix D>=1 before M tends to infinity

proved: The exact parameter tower is (h_j,s_j,p_j,M)=(h-4j,s+3j,p+2j,M), with h>=4D+1 for a full forward window.
The at most 4D phase-boundary rows have O_D(log M) prime-log weight.
On every unit transport chart, the exact multi-prime solution module is the product over j in J of ker(A_j mod p_j).
For local ranks r_j in {0,1,2}, the solution count is the product over j in J of p_j^(4-r_j); all rank drops are retained.
Over Z/N_J Z, every 4x4 minor of the 2t-row CRT idempotent gate matrix vanishes because every four-row selection meets two orthogonal idempotent blocks.
This mixed-minor obstruction holds regardless of rational multi-plane transversality and prevents the natural plane stack from forcing full product divisibility of the state.
The exact J={0,1,4}, primes 29,31,37 model has a determinant-one rational substack, all 15 CRT maximal minors zero, and a non-N-divisible vector satisfying every local gate.
Every collision cluster implies (product p_j)^2 divides gcd(C0(M),C1(M)); this is exactly a subproduct of the existing Item197/264 square radical.
Overlapping patterns must be radicalized, so repeated cluster membership gives no extra valuation at an endpoint prime.
For fixed D, all transport singular factors and boundary rows have O_D(log M) prime-log weight.
For every fixed pattern J of size t, the classical Selberg upper-bound sieve gives O_(D,t)(M/log^t M) ambient prime clusters.
Uniformly over all patterns of fixed size t and diameter at most D, endpoint prime-log weight is O_(D,t)(M/log^(t-1) M)=o(M).
The union over all non-singleton patterns of diameter at most D has O_D(M/log M)=o(M) endpoint prime-log weight.
The bounded-cluster mechanism cannot lower the raw 1/36 per 6M fixed-j=1 ceiling because the isolated-prime gate remains uncontrolled.
